spans.s: koraṇḍaka (m. or nt.; = Pali id., cf. Skt. kuraṇṭaka, Lex. kuraṇḍaka, and see BR 〔5.1330〕 koraṇḍaka, n. pr., and ˚ṭaka-grāma), n. of a certain shrub and its flower: Mmk 〔711.6〕 (prose) raktaśālituṣāgirikarṇikā-koraṇḍakabījaṃ.

korpara, kaurpara, m. (= AMg. koppara, Skt. kūrpara; Skt. kaurpara only adj.; not recorded in Pali, where the equivalent word is kappara), elbow: kaurparau, dual, Mmk 〔157.4〕; in cpds. kaurpara Mmk 〔69.12〕; kor˚ 〔76.12〕; 〔305.10〕; 〔436.3〕.
